measures.title: Morgan County: probate judge qualifications and equity jurisdiction (Act 2025-416)
measures.summary: A local amendment to the Constitution of Alabama of 2022 that applies only to Morgan County. It would require the judge of probate to be an attorney licensed in Alabama and would authorize the judge of probate to exercise equity jurisdiction concurrent with the circuit court.
measures.yesMeans: The Morgan County probate judge would have to be a licensed Alabama attorney and could hear equity matters alongside the circuit court.
measures.noMeans: The constitution is not amended and the probate judge's qualifications and jurisdiction stay as they are.

measures.title: Morgan County: senior property tax exemption (Act 2026-142)
measures.summary: A local amendment to the Constitution of Alabama of 2022 that applies only to Morgan County. It would let a qualified taxpayer age 65 or older claim a senior property tax exemption on real property under certain conditions.
measures.yesMeans: Qualified Morgan County taxpayers 65 or older could claim a senior property tax exemption on real property under certain conditions.
measures.noMeans: The constitution is not amended and this senior exemption does not take effect.
